name: Permanent Media File Delete
description: Permanently deletes the underlying file when a media item's file is replaced/removed (extends Media File Delete).
project_description:
This module provides additional functionality for Media file delete to permanently remove orphaned files if existing media is replaced with new one.

 Features 
 When any existing media is replaced with new media then orphaned files gets deleted from files table.

 Post-Installation 
 Once module is installed, under content create new media of type Images, Documents, Audio, Video and save. Edit the newly created and replace the existing with new one and save. Under Content > Files the replaced file will get deleted.

 Additional Requirements 
 To Enable this module it needs Media File Delete contributed module.

 Recommended modules/libraries 
 This module Provides Additional functionality to Media File Delete contributed module.
